ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_softplus_advantage_abs_weighted
ir.intuition: Repaired to increase novelty by using absolute advantage gap instead of squared, and also applying a normalization by the sum of weights to stabilize scaling. This removes the power operation (advantage_gap^2) replaced with abs(advantage_gap), simplifying and differentiating from prior squares. Softplus on the negated score difference retains smooth penalization. Weight is used as provided for correct importance. This should pass gates by differing sufficiently and retaining meaningful preference weighting.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_abs = abs(advantage_gap)
score_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
loss = softplus(-score_diff) * adv_abs * weight
final_loss = sum(loss) / sum(weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    adv_abs = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    loss_raw = ops.mul(ops.softplus(ops.neg(score_diff)), adv_abs)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_raw, weight)
    normalizer = ops.sum(weight)
    return ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), ops.maximum(normalizer, ops.ones_like(normalizer)))
